no-restricted-syntax.message: Redirect target is missing a trailing slash. next.config.mjs sets `trailingSlash: true`, so a slashless path 301s to `http://…:8080/…/` in production (leaks the internal ingress port + downgrades protocol → users get stuck). Use '/login/' not '/login', '/dashboard/' not '/dashboard'.
